import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,re
p=Path.cwd(); data=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())
for i,v in data.items(): print(i,v['parsed']['statement'])
allow=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); print('ALLOW_TYPE',type(allow).__name__)
if isinstance(allow,dict): print('ALLOW_KEYS',list(allow))
paths=allow if isinstance(allow,list) else allow.get('paths',[])
ids=set(data); matches=[]; count=0; filtered=0
for s in paths:
 if re.search('crown|tournament|bunkbed',s,re.I): filtered+=1; continue
 f=Path(s); b=f.read_bytes(); count+=1
 # Exact IDs only; source-family search deferred to avoid large unrelated body output.
 if not any(re.search(r'(?<!\d)'+i+r'(?!\d)',b.decode()) for i in ids): continue
 obj=json.loads(b)
 matches.append({'path':s,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'body':obj})
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'historical-exact-matches.json'],input=json.dumps({'files_read':count,'protected_name_filtered':filtered,'matches':matches},indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10); assert r.returncode==0
print('HISTORY_COUNTS',count,filtered,len(matches))
for m in matches: print('MATCH',m['path'],json.dumps(m['body'])[:10000])
